items.period: Shang oracle-bone script style; specific ancient object/date not identified by the asset page
items.tradition: Chinese oracle-bone script; modern digital redraw
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of an oracle-script form of 果, presented as a tree with fruit above it. It illustrates the reported graphic analysis, rather than showing an excavated inscription.
items.alt: Modern black vector outline of an early 果 graph, with a tree-like lower element and clustered marks above.
items.selection_reason: The Commons description ties this particular form to 果 and names source character J14163; CUHK independently explains the early graph as fruit on 木. The Commons page reports public-domain reuse for the redraw.
items.rights: Public domain according to the Commons file page; attribution appreciated. Digital redraw, not ancient artifact photography.

limitations.text: The direct candidate is a modern redraw, not an artifact photograph, and the image viewer rejected its SVG payload; no pixel-level inspection is claimed. Its provenance and depiction label come from the inspected Commons page.
The Academia Sinica character evolution page is useful linked evidence, but its separate rights notice reserves rights over images; no image from that database is proposed for reuse.
